protocol: Use every retained correction draw and all four NUTS chains on the original 192-event test catalog. Retain unweighted, raw, and PSIS predictions. Check event resolution with the previous independent 2048-sample integrations and fixed systematic posterior resamples. Reuse the archived fine baseline predictions after provenance checks.
decision: Report paired test-event score differences and standard errors, eventwise discrepancy from MCMC predictions, repeat variability, and changes with numerical resolution. Positive scores alone do not establish a predictive advantage; retain negative and inconclusive results. Do not tune the correction using these test events.
